notes.title: 1.23 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/72e21476999d5ddccbbfd1f31a0479c52f5ed799.png[/img]

[h1]1.23 Patch Notes[/h1]
[h1]Invite Your Friends[/h1]
[list][*]You can now invite your friends to join you in [i]Eternal[/i]![/*][/list]
[list][*]Here are the benefits to inviting your friends:[/*]
[list][*]Earn rewards for the first 10 friends that you get to join and complete all of the Scion campaigns, including Wump and Nictotraxian avatars that can’t be earned anywhere else![/*][/list]
[list][*]Your friends will receive a unique Valkyrie theme deck with a premium Valkyrie Spireguard![/*][/list]
[list][*]You’ll earn a unique Yeti theme deck with a premium Wump, Party Starter card![/*][/list][/list]
[h1]Founder Packages[/h1]
Thank you for being a part of [i]Eternal[/i] and helping us grow!
[list][*]As a special thank you, Founder Packages have been added to the store for a limited time only.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Everyone can purchase the Molot & Nakova premium avatar from the store for 300 Gems![/*][/list]
[list][*]There are three additional Founder Packages. Choose the Founder Package that suits you![/*]
[list][*][b]The Eternal Throne Package:[/b][/*]
[list][*]1,000 Gems[/*][/list]
[list][*]The Eternal Throne totem[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*][b]The Bounty Hunter Package:[/b][/*]
[list][*]2,000 Gems[/*][/list]
[list][*]The Eternal Throne totem[/*][/list]
[list][*]Complete set of Premium Sigils (unlimited quantity, just like the basic sigils)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Premium Jekk avatar with custom bullet-hole VFX on the playmat[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*][b]The Liberator Package:[/b][/*]
[list][*]6,000 Gems[/*][/list]
[list][*]The Eternal Throne totem[/*][/list]
[list][*]Complete set of Premium Sigils[/*][/list]
[list][*]Premium Jekk, the Bounty Hunter avatar[/*][/list]
[list][*]Premium Icaria avatar with custom valkyrie wing VFX on the playmat[/*][/list][/list][/list]
[list][*]While most of the content from the Founder Packages will be removed from the store after the limited time availability, the Eternal Throne totem will remain available in the totem page of the store for 900 gems.[/*][/list]
[h1]Puzzles[/h1]
[list][*]Puzzles are now available![/*][/list]
[list][*]There are 80 new Puzzles that range in difficulty from learning how battle skills interact to more challenging brain-teasers.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Each puzzle offers a gold reward for completing it.[/*][/list]
[h1]Card Updates[/h1]
[i]The following cards have changed. Shiftstone refunds will be available for a limited time for all copies you had previously crafted.[/i]
[b]These changes fall under three specific areas:[/b]
[list][*]Buffs to enable more Time, Justice, Primal, and Shadow strategies:[/*]
[list][*]Aid of the Hooru (now draw four instead of draw two)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Avirax Familiar (now 1/2 instead of 1/1)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Banish (now 3-cost instead of 4-cost)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Bloodcall Invocation (now 1-cost instead of 2-cost)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Bloodletter (now +3/+3 instead of +3/+2)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Cat Burglar (now 3/2 instead of 2/2)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Crownwatch Squire (now 1/2 instead of 1/1)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Evelina, Valley Searcher (now 2-cost instead of 3-cost)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Fencing Master (now 3J instead of 3JJ)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Mask of Torment (now 20-cost ultimate instead of 25-cost)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Minotaur Lighthoof (now 4-cost 4/4 instead of 5-cost 4/5)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Watcher of the Big Ones (now 4-cost 3/6 instead of 5-cost 4/6)[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*]Nerfs to pull back on Armory, while also increasing diversity among Armory strategies:[/*]
[list][*]Smuggler's Stash (now costs 6FS instead of 5FS)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Inspire (now costs 2J instead of 1J)[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*]All three of the Powersurge cards have been reworked and the Powersurge skill has been removed:[/*]
[list][*]Charchain Flail - Now 2FF +1/+1, Summon: Spend your remaining power to give Charchain Flail that much strength.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Copper Conduit - Now 2T 1/1, Overwhelm Summon: Spend your remaining power to give Copper Conduit that much strength and health.[/*]
[list][*]Additionally, there was custom enter-play logic that allowed it and some other cards to interact with cards that cared about stats as they entered-play. In order to line up the rules around Summon abilities, this interaction has been removed.[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*]Flame Blast - Now 2FFF, Deal 1 damage. Spend your remaining power to increase the damage dealt by that much.[/*][/list][/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list][*]All of the basic totems have had “miss” VFX added for clicks that don’t activate the flag animation.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Additional phone-specific interface updates.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The crafting animation for creating and destroying cards has been updated.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Premium cards now have a subtle animation to the card frame.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Premium cards have an additional highlight during pack opening.[/*][/list]
[list][*]All non-basic power cards have received an updated frame.[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]Empty spaces at the end of a line should no longer invalidate a decklist for import.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The Skill Up achievement should no longer count each instance of Warcry as a separate skill.[/*][/list]
[b]Phone[/b]
[list][*]Trying to emote while your hand is zoomed should now correctly emote instead of unzooming your hand.[/*][/list]
[list][*]X in deckbuilder search should now correctly clear text in the field.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Progress text accompanying the chest opening after winning a Casual game should no longer say "Ranked".[/*][/list]
[list][*]You should now be able to tap-and-hold to look at units on the playmat when observing a friend.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Android devices should now have a quit button in options.[/*][/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]You should now be able to see the highlight for which cards your opponent is looking at in their hand again.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The wooden chests opened from winning a Casual game should now show the correct amount of gold earned.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Observing a friend during redraw should no longer remove their avatar and power from the playmat.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Achievements and quest progress should now wait until the Victory/Defeat screen before appearing.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The options to test initial draw and redraw should no longer disappear when leaving and returning to the sample hand feature.[/*][/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Playing a spell with Destiny that would prevent a unit from dying in response to a damage spell should no longer make the unit disappear from the game.[/*][/list][/list]
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Copies of Rilgon, Hooru Operative should now correctly lose Double Damage according to the card’s rules.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Means to an End should no longer be able to fire multiple instances of 25 damage if you gain multiple instances of health and have no cards left in your deck.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Means to an End should now count its damage dealt toward the Shadow Warrior quest.[/*][/list]
[list][*]If Cloud of Ash is negated, it should no longer leave fire VFX on the opponent for the rest of the game.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Slimespitter Slug should no longer continue to gain health while in your hand when an enemy unit dies after being returned to your hand.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Fencing Master’s ultimate should no longer activate when a stun spell hits an enemy unit with endurance since that unit is immune to stun.[/*][/list]
[list][*]There should no longer be a long delay between Jarall’s Frostkin’s projectile and its impact animation.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Enemy players that discard cards due to Azindel’s Gift should now correctly show a single copy of each card discarded.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Units that have been stolen, damaged, and then returned to their owner should now heal the correct amount at the end of the turn if their owner has a Xenan Obelisk in play.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Sindok, Rage Incarnate should retain its cost reduction after being returned to hand.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Units with Lifeforce abilities which resolve at the end of your turn should no longer get the VFX hint if you gain life during your opponent’s turn.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Health should no longer be gained when an enemy unit dies when you have both Slimespitter Slug and Statuary Maiden in play.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Lumbering Gruan should no longer stun itself in response to getting attacked by a relic weapon.[/*][/list]
[list][*]You should no longer be able to select the same card for multiple Memory Dredgers hitting the enemy player.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Cards transformed into monuments due to Knucklebones should now properly transmute when drawn.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The copy created from an Echo spell that had its damage modified by Maelstrom Bell should now properly retain the increased damage.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Strength of Many should no longer be able to be played on enemy units.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Armorsmith should now correctly reset its cost if it is stolen by a player that doesn’t have any armor.[/*][/list]

[list][*]Fencing Master (now 3J instead of 3JJ)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Mask of Torment (now 20-cost ultimate instead of 25-cost)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Minotaur Lighthoof (now 4-cost 4/4 instead of 5-cost 4/5)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Watcher of the Big Ones (now 4-cost 3/6 instead of 5-cost 4/6)[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*]Nerfs to pull back on Armory, while also increasing diversity among Armory strategies:[/*]
[list][*]Smuggler's Stash (now costs 6FS instead of 5FS)[/*][/list]
[list][*]Inspire (now costs 2J instead of 1J)[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*]All three of the Powersurge cards have been reworked and the Powersurge skill has been removed:[/*]
[list][*]Charchain Flail - Now 2FF +1/+1, Summon: Spend your remaining power to give Charchain Flail that much strength.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Copper Conduit - Now 2T 1/1, Overwhelm Summon: Spend your remaining power to give Copper Conduit that much strength and health.[/*]
[list][*]Additionally, there was custom enter-play logic that allowed it and some other cards to interact with cards that cared about stats as they entered-play. In order to line up the rules around Summon abilities, this interaction has been removed.[/*][/list][/list]
[list][*]Flame Blast - Now 2FFF, Deal 1 damage. Spend your remaining power to increase the damage dealt by that much.[/*][/list][/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list][*]All of the basic totems have had “miss” VFX added for clicks that don’t activate the flag animation.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Additional phone-specific interface updates.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The crafting animation for creating and destroying cards has been updated.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Premium cards now have a subtle animation to the card frame.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Premium cards have an additional highlight during pack opening.[/*][/list]
[list][*]All non-basic power cards have received an updated frame.[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]Empty spaces at the end of a line should no longer invalidate a decklist for import.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The Skill Up achievement should no longer count each instance of Warcry as a separate skill.[/*][/list]
[b]Phone[/b]
[list][*]Trying to emote while your hand is zoomed should now correctly emote instead of unzooming your hand.[/*][/list]
[list][*]X in deckbuilder search should now correctly clear text in the field.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Progress text accompanying the chest opening after winning a Casual game should no longer say "Ranked".[/*][/list]
[list][*]You should now be able to tap-and-hold to look at units on the playmat when observing a friend.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Android devices should now have a quit button in options.[/*][/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]You should now be able to see the highlight for which cards your opponent is looking at in their hand again.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The wooden chests opened from winning a Casual game should now show the correct amount of gold earned.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Observing a friend during redraw should no longer remove their avatar and power from the playmat.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Achievements and quest progress should now wait until the Victory/Defeat screen before appearing.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The options to test initial draw and redraw should no longer disappear when leaving and returning to the sample hand feature.[/*][/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Playing a spell with Destiny that would prevent a unit from dying in response to a damage spell should no longer make the unit disappear from the game.[/*][/list][/list]
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Copies of Rilgon, Hooru Operative should now correctly lose Double Damage according to the card’s rules.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Means to an End should no longer be able to fire multiple instances of 25 damage if you gain multiple instances of health and have no cards left in your deck.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Means to an End should now count its damage dealt toward the Shadow Warrior quest.[/*][/list]
[list][*]If Cloud of Ash is negated, it should no longer leave fire VFX on the opponent for the rest of the game.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Slimespitter Slug should no longer continue to gain health while in your hand when an enemy unit dies after being returned to your hand.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Fencing Master’s ultimate should no longer activate when a stun spell hits an enemy unit with endurance since that unit is immune to stun.[/*][/list]
[list][*]There should no longer be a long delay between Jarall’s Frostkin’s projectile and its impact animation.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Enemy players that discard cards due to Azindel’s Gift should now correctly show a single copy of each card discarded.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Units that have been stolen, damaged, and then returned to their owner should now heal the correct amount at the end of the turn if their owner has a Xenan Obelisk in play.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Sindok, Rage Incarnate should retain its cost reduction after being returned to hand.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Units with Lifeforce abilities which resolve at the end of your turn should no longer get the VFX hint if you gain life during your opponent’s turn.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Health should no longer be gained when an enemy unit dies when you have both Slimespitter Slug and Statuary Maiden in play.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Lumbering Gruan should no longer stun itself in response to getting attacked by a relic weapon.[/*][/list]
[list][*]You should no longer be able to select the same card for multiple Memory Dredgers hitting the enemy player.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Cards transformed into monuments due to Knucklebones should now properly transmute when drawn.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The copy created from an Echo spell that had its damage modified by Maelstrom Bell should now properly retain the increased damage.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Strength of Many should no longer be able to be played on enemy units.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Armorsmith should now correctly reset its cost if it is stolen by a player that doesn’t have any armor.[/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.22 Patch Notes: Omens of the Past
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/1768ac0774103bf0879dea5407cd3599effe828e.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Set: Omens of the Past[/h1]
[list][*]A new set hits [i]Eternal[/i] with over 250 new cards and new mechanics![/*][/list]
[list][*]Draft format has changed to alternate between Omens of the Past and The Empty Throne packs.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The new set is now available for purchase from the store and can be crafted via Shiftstone.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Theme decks for Omens of the Past are now available for purchase in the store.[/*][url=http://www.direwolfdigital.com/eternal/omens-of-the-past-theme-decks/]Theme Decks[/url][/list]
[list][*]Forge Wolf, Cloudsnake Hatchling and the five Banners have been moved to Omens of the Past to support the Draft mode.[/*][/list]
[h1]Gauntlet/Forge Season End[/h1]
[list][*]Progress for all players has been reset in both Gauntlet and Forge with the addition of Omens of the Past.[/*][/list]
[list][*]New AI opponents have been added, including five new bosses in the Gauntlet.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Some existing AI decks have been updated to include cards from Omens of the Past.[/*][/list]
[h1]Phone Support[/h1]
[list][*]Phones now have custom UI and features to make Eternal more user-friendly on mobile devices. This includes:[/*]
[list][*]Larger card tiles in deckbuilder.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Deck list can be collapsed while drafting.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Customized playmat layout with a hand that can expand/collapse.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Streamlined interactions with many elements of the UI to work better on phones.[/*][/list][/list]
[h1]Casual Mode[/h1]
[list][*]Casual queue is now available![/*][/list]
[h1]Premium Cards[/h1]
[list][*]Premium cards now have a unique premium frame treatment.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Premium and non-premium cards now stack in deck lists.[/*][/list]
[h1]Card Updates[/h1]
[list][*]Navani, Warsinger now has unique VFX indicating that her Warcry hits the entire deck.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Many cards from The Empty Throne have been updated to adhere to new wording templates.[/*][/list]
[h1]Rewards Update[/h1]
[list][*]A ‘First Win of the Day’ reward has been added to grant a free pack from Omens of the Past for your first Ranked or Casual win each day.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The reward cycle in Ranked has been updated.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Cards from Bronze, Silver and Diamond chests can now include cards from Omens of the Past.[/*][/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list][*]The client has been updated with a new font.[/*][/list]
[list][*]General UI updates throughout the client.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Chat has been streamlined with several quality of life improvements.[/*][/list]
[list][*]A glossary of all skills, battle skills, and card types has been added to the options menu.[/*][/list]
[h1]Matchmaking[/h1]
[list][*]The Masters rank has been updated to better incentivize skill compared to raw number of games played.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Some high MMR players were experiencing difficulty climbing in subsequent seasons due to the difference in their MMR and the MMR of their opponents. To alleviate this, the penalty for playing against a lower MMR player has been removed.[/*][/list]
[h1]Turn Timer Updates[/h1]
[list][*]Turn timers have been updated to reduce the negative impact of players who intentionally abuse their turn timers.[/*][/list]
[h1]Theme Deck Quests[/h1]
[list][*]The delay between Theme Deck Quests has been reduced to 3 days from 7.[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]Controllers should now be able to zoom cards in the rare slot during pack opening.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Idling out during a Gauntlet or Forge game should now correctly count the game as a loss.[/*][/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]You should now be able to receive tool-tips for playmat elements after a game ends, before the victory/defeat screen.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Rarely, the End Turn button would disable and not be clickable. That should no longer happen.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Weapon hangers should now use the correct hanger layout for weapons.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Mousing-over your avatar before the resolution of a unit played from Destiny that has a summon ability should no longer cause a blank card hanger to display.[/*][/list]
[list][*]It should no longer be possible to cause a mouse-over zoom on a unit to rapidly switch sides during the zoom.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The last played opponent in the social menu should now include opponents from Events.[/*][/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Drawing a card with Destiny when it can’t be played (ex: Scourge of Frosthome is in play) should now discard the Destiny card and draw a new card.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Drawing a card with Destiny that has no legal play should now discard the Destiny card and draw a new card.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Units that have lifesteal and an Entomb ability that deals damage should now grant you health equal to the damage dealt.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Lifesteal should now correctly resolve if the source was killed in response (example: killing a Black Sky Harbinger in response to its damage should no longer prevent the health gain).[/*][/list][/list] 
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Dawnwalker should no longer play his summon VFX over the enemy totem as he returns from the void.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Borderlands Waykeeper should now correctly play a VFX when using her ultimate ability.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Icebreaker should now correctly shoot its VFX to the unit it is targeting rather than itself.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Shadowlands Feaster should now correctly steal all units to your void when multiple die simultaneously.[/*][/list]
[list][*]A Nictotraxian with Echo that creates a card with Echo should now correctly Echo that created card.[/*][/list]
[list][*]A Nictotraxian with Echo should now correctly present itself to the opponent.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Crown of Possibilities should now correctly grant a skill to a unit created by a Nictotraxian with Echo.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Diplomatic Seal should no longer clip through other cards in hand when being played.[/*][/list][url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/1768ac0774103bf0879dea5407cd3599effe828e.jpg][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/f42c8ea81af8b90c7420557fc58d930c2e8ce8ad.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: 1.21 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/b02ce07c60980c52475654270864f82ba1e10dfb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Promo Quest[/h1]
[list][*]Veteran Mercenary is now available! Earn one copy of Veteran Mercenary for your first Versus Battle win each day while the promo is available.[/*][/list]
[h1]Events[/h1]
[list][*]An event button has been added to the home page. Be on the lookout for unique, timed Events in the future![/*]
[list][*]The event mode button has taken the place of the casual mode. But, fear not! Casual is still a mode we intend to support in a future patch.[/*][/list][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]Minimizing the client should no longer remove the framerate cap.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Reporting another player in chat should now prevent them from sending you additional messages.[/*][/list]
[b]Android/iOS[/b]
[list][*]Multiple performance improvements for Android and iOS.[/*][/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]Leaving a game you were observing and re-joining it should no longer display the End Turn button in Greek, regardless of language selected.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The settings menu during login should now include a slider to control card voice volume.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Completing multiple quests should no longer stack the progress display when claiming the rewards.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Power and influence UI should now correctly appear if you observe a friend right as their game is starting.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The network indicator signaling a poor networking connection should no longer be hidden while in a queue.[/*][/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Weapons that grant aegis should now correctly transfer the aegis when the unit transforms (if the aegis hadn’t previously been used).[/*][/list]
[list][*]Damage spells should now correctly consume the aegis from units that are invulnerable to damage, even if they would have dealt no damage to the unit.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Lifegain should now be batched into single triggers rather than individual instances during simultaneous lifegain from a single source. Example: Black-Sky Harbinger will now grant a single instance of health rather than multiple instances of +1.[/*][/list][/list] 
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Azindel, the Wayfinder should now correctly grant his new owner the max power benefit when stolen.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Azindel, the Wayfinder should now correctly increase max power when a unit moves between voids.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Azindel, the Wayfinder should now correctly increase max power when The Tormentor enters the void from Whispers in the Void.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Azindel, the Wayfinder should no longer increase max power when a relic is killed.[/*][/list]

notes.title: 1.21 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/b02ce07c60980c52475654270864f82ba1e10dfb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Promo Quest[/h1]
[list][*]Veteran Mercenary is now available! Earn one copy of Veteran Mercenary for your first Versus Battle win each day while the promo is available.[/*][/list]
[h1]Events[/h1]
[list][*]An event button has been added to the home page. Be on the lookout for unique, timed Events in the future![/*]
[list][*]The event mode button has taken the place of the casual mode. But, fear not! Casual is still a mode we intend to support in a future patch.[/*][/list][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]Minimizing the client should no longer remove the framerate cap.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Reporting another player in chat should now prevent them from sending you additional messages.[/*][/list]
[b]Android/iOS[/b]
[list][*]Multiple performance improvements for Android and iOS.[/*][/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]Leaving a game you were observing and re-joining it should no longer display the End Turn button in Greek, regardless of language selected.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The settings menu during login should now include a slider to control card voice volume.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Completing multiple quests should no longer stack the progress display when claiming the rewards.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Power and influence UI should now correctly appear if you observe a friend right as their game is starting.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The network indicator signaling a poor networking connection should no longer be hidden while in a queue.[/*][/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Weapons that grant aegis should now correctly transfer the aegis when the unit transforms (if the aegis hadn’t previously been used).[/*][/list]
[list][*]Damage spells should now correctly consume the aegis from units that are invulnerable to damage, even if they would have dealt no damage to the unit.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Lifegain should now be batched into single triggers rather than individual instances during simultaneous lifegain from a single source. Example: Black-Sky Harbinger will now grant a single instance of health rather than multiple instances of +1.[/*][/list][/list] 
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Azindel, the Wayfinder should now correctly grant his new owner the max power benefit when stolen.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Azindel, the Wayfinder should now correctly increase max power when a unit moves between voids.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Azindel, the Wayfinder should now correctly increase max power when The Tormentor enters the void from Whispers in the Void.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Azindel, the Wayfinder should no longer increase max power when a relic is killed.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Distant Lands - 1.20 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/83911c1db8bd806b22eee4b179957b2436fbfbac.png[/img][h1]Features[/h1]
[b]Promo Quest: Distant Lands[/b]
[list][*]Your first PvP win of the day over the next few weeks will earn you a copy of both Alpine Tracker and Oathbreaker. Once the promo period is over, you’ll be able to craft the cards using Shiftstone as normal.[/*][/list]
[b]Localization[/b]
[list][*][i]Eternal[/i] can now be played in a variety of different languages, including: French, Italian, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese, Greek, and Turkish.  If you're playing Eternal in one of our newly supported languages, we'd love your help testing and refining the translation of the game. [/*][/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]Decks and voids on the playmat now have depth related to the number of cards they contain.[/*][/list]
[list][*]After a prolonged period of inactivity, players will now say a standardized emote to indicate the lack of action.[/*][/list]
[list][*]You can now emote after you’ve lost a game.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Estimated waits for finding an opponent during match-making have been tuned to be more accurate in some cases.[/*][/list]
[h1]Card Updates[/h1]
[list][*]All five Scions now have unique VFX when entering the playmat.[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]Rarely, you would enter an empty playmat when observing a friend. This should no longer happen.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Some draft games had connection issues that would cause you to lose games on start. This should no longer occur. If you experience this issue, please send feedback through the in-game feedback option.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Gauntlet runs that end with no rewards should now clean up on their own and no longer require you to enter the event and click ‘done’.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Timing out with a Reckless unit in play should no longer prevent your timer from reducing on subsequent turns.[/*][/list]
[b]Android/iOS[/b]
[list][*]Units that have Killer or a targeted ability should no longer require dragging and will now work after tapping the unit.[/*][/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]You should no longer be able to accidentally select presented cards behind a selection box on the playmat.[/*][/list][/list]
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]VO lines should no longer play their VO when drawn by effects.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Dawnwalker should correctly play his summon VO when re-entering play from the void.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Stormcaller can no longer hit herself with her ability.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Eternal Patch 1.19 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/aafcefb45550f3c9b1ae0ae3cc9d90925f5fa68f.png[/img]

[h1]Features[/h1]
[b]Iteration on the New-Player Campaign & Tutorial[/b]
[list][*]Improved tutorial to better onboard new players to [i]Eternal’s[/i] mechanics.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The campaign now features a fleshed-out story. Learn about the five Scions, as told by Jekk.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Uncover the truth behind the Empty Throne.[/*][/list]
[b]Voices Added to Eternal[/b]
[list][*]Cinematics, campaigns, and many cards now have voiced lines when played.[/*][/list]
[list][*]All units have attack and death SFX.[/*][/list]
[b]Store Pricing Updated[/b]
[i]We’ve heard your feedback about gem thresholds in the store and have updated some aspects of the pricing structure.[/i]
[list][*]The $10 Gem package now gives 1,100 gems, up from 1,050.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The 3, 7, and 16 pack bundles have been removed from the store.[/*][/list]
[list][*]You can now buy single packs for 1,000 gold or 100 gems.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Anyone who purchased gems and has a gem total that isn’t divisible by 100 will have their gems rounded up to the nearest 100.[/*][/list]
[b]Observer Mode[/b]
[list][*]You can now watch friends play games live! Click on the “eye” icon beside their name in your friend list.[/*][/list]
[list][*]If you don’t want to be observed, there is an option in the settings to deny observers.[/*][/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]The badge display on the playmat now shows your current rank, rather than last season’s rank.[/*][/list]
[list][*]It should now be easier to identify who is going first at the start of the game.[/*][/list]
[list][*]You can now report another player from the chat window for abusive speech.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Updated the deck art for Champion of Chaos to match her new card art.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Updated the timer visuals indicating when a player is almost out of time for their turn.[/*][/list]
[h1]Card Updates[/h1]
[list][*]Blazing Renegade and Oni Striker have swapped name and art. No functional changes.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The Great Parliament now tells you how many owls it will play in the card text.[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]The client should now correctly open in its last saved resolution for Surface Pro users instead of defaulting back to the device’s native resolution.[/*][/list]
[list][*]After disconnecting from a ranked or draft game, players should no longer see their PvP point change for that disconnected game following their next gauntlet game.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Rarely, getting the exact same rewards for both ranked and draft would cause one set of rewards to not be granted properly. This should no longer occur and you should always get your season rewards for both ranked and draft.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Players should no longer fail to join some draft games, resulting in a timeout loss.[/*][/list]
[list][*]You should no longer be able to accidentally enter a gauntlet without having selected a deck.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Cards acquired from Jekk’s Bounty should now correctly use the collection diamonds that indicate they cannot be destroyed.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Cards with ambush should now correctly present to the opponent when played as an ambush.[/*][/list]
[b]Android/iOS[/b]
[list][*]Performance optimizations for low-end Android devices.[/*][/list]
[list][*]There should no longer be a long delay to receive your gems if you crash after a purchase on Android.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The totem preview button should now render correctly on the shield tv.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Totems should now appear correctly on Android devices without artifacting.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Interruptions during a purchase on iOS should no longer cause the purchase to fail.[/*][/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]Multiple small UI bug fixes throughout the client.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Multiple improvements to how friends display and interact in the friend’s list.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The influence breakdown chart in the advanced deckbuilder view should now represent factionless cards correctly.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Hidden achievements should now correctly appear as completed in the achievement list without needing to restart the client.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The turn button should no longer say “Fight!” when the attacker has a response to an opponent’s action. It will now correctly say “Continue”.[/*][/list][/list]
[/list]
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Having multiple Shadowlands Feasters in play will now longer cause stolen units to bounce back and forth between voids.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Rilgon should no longer receive double damage for the turn following a spell cast during the end of a turn.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Burn Out will no longer instruct you to sacrifice a unit after you have already picked a unit to sacrifice.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Infernus should no longer immediately die when he is brought back to play using Haunting Scream.[/*][/list]
[list][*]All Seats and Banners now have “depleted” in bold.[/*][/list]
[list][*]‘Empty the Coffers’ boss power should no longer be stopped by aegis.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Rarely, Steward of the Past would not silence Gorgon Fanatic when it entered the void. Gorgon Fanatic should no longer be an exception and will now always be silenced by Steward of the Past.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Cabal Spymaster will now correctly lose his aura when silenced.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Dawnwalker should no longer present to players when returning from the void.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Spells brought back by multiple West-Wind Heralds should no longer block the player from being able to target units underneath the card presentation.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Argenport Instigator should now correctly damage the player if one of their units transforms into another unit that immediately dies.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Sigils that become depleted (from effects like Find the Way) should now stay depleted if they leave your hand.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Rebel Sharpshooter should now correctly get +3/+3, gain Quickdraw and create an accurate copy when targeted with Strength of the Pack.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Brightmace Paladin should now correctly get +3/+3, gain Lifesteal and create an accurate copy when targeted with Strength of the Pack.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Crownwatch Cavalry should no longer add temporary buffs it had to the unit it buffs if it is played again after being returned to hand.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Mark of Shame should no longer apply the -3/-0 if it gets silenced.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Eternal Patch 1.18 - Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/3cac9526a6843be82b822e4aefc4d4c5df5090ef.png[/img]


[h1]1.18 Patch Notes[/h1][h1]Features[/h1][b]Theme Deck Quest Update[/b][list][*]Players that haven’t completed all of their theme deck quests will now have a counter in their quest display to indicate when the next quest will come and what deck they’ll receive.[/*][/list][b]Totems[/b][list][*]The 5 basic totems can now be purchased for 300 gems each. notes.notes:

[h1]1.17 Patch Notes[/h1][h1]New Campaign: Jekk's Bounty[/h1]Jekk’s Bounty is now live! Join forces with Jekk, the infamous bounty hunter, as you track down some of the most dangerous criminals and creatures across the world.[list][*]Unlock Jekk's Bounty with 20,000 Gold or 1,000 Gems.[/*][/list][list][*]Earn four copies of 16 all-new cards as you complete 16 unique missions.[/*][/list][list][*]You can preview all 16 cards in Jekk’s Bounty in game![/*][/list][h1]Features[/h1][b]Guest Mode[/b]New players joining [i]Eternal[/i] no longer require a registered account upfront. Instead, we’ll ask you for that information after you’ve gotten a chance to check out the game.[list][*]Existing users should see no difference in their login flow.[/*][/list][b]Social Improvements[/b]We’ve upgraded a lot of back-end functionality with the friends list. If you come across bugs or issues with the social systems, please report them using the in-game feedback.[b]UI[/b][list][*]Various UI improvements and updates throughout the client.[/*][/list][list][*]Collection progression in the profile has been updated to include incremental progress.[/*][/list][list][*]Your current rank and points are now displayed in Ranked deck select.[/*][/list][list][*]You can now preview your current rewards, the rewards for the next rank and find information for when the current season ends by tool-tipping your Ranked or Draft badge.[/*][/list][list][*]Victory/Defeat progress celebrations at the end of versus games have been updated.[/*][/list][list][*]Gem purchase flow improvements.[/*][/list][h1]Card Updates[/h1][list][*]Sandstorm Titan - Sandstorm Titan no longer has a flowing scarf as part of his VFX package.[/*][/list][list][*]Whispers of the Void - The Tormentor now has a suitable entrance when he enters the void.[/*][/list][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][b]Client Fixes[/b][list][b]General[/b][list][*]Fixed several card animation curves on the playmat. Cards should transition to and from various zones more cleanly now.[/*][/list][b]Android/iOS[/b][list][*]Rarely, making a purchase on Android would prevent further input, gating you on that screen. This should no longer occur.[/*][/list][list][*]Android users should now get their 3 free packs immediately after their first purchase rather than at a delayed time.[/*][/list][list][*]Closing chat windows should now correctly dismiss the onscreen keyboard.[/*][/list][b]UI[/b][list][*]Gauntlet now correctly celebrates earning Bronze from Unranked.[/*][/list][list][*]Rarely, an opponent’s name would appear as a different player on the playmat. This should no longer occur.[/*][/list][list][*]The double damage highlight on a unit’s strength now highlights the number correctly instead of covering it.[/*][/list][list][*]Rarely your rank point display after a game would show the delta from your previous game rather than the one you just completed. This has been fixed.[/*][/list][list][*]Create All should now properly appear under your deck list if you have any unowned cards in your deck list.[/*][/list][b]Gameplay[/b][list][*]Relic weapon attacks with overwhelm now correctly redirect the damage to the opponent if the target became a cudgel in response to the attack.[/*][/list][list][*]Stolen units that return to your side should now go to your void if you’re at the unit cap.[/*][/list][list][*]All Fate triggers should now trigger after Echo if a card drawn has both.[/*][/list][/list][/list][b]Card Fixes[/b][list][*]Flight Lieutenant now has a hanger for Flying.[/*][/list][list][*]Minimizing the selection for Diplomatic Seal and then cancelling the action should no longer adversely affect the Sigil count for future Sigil draws from your deck.[/*][/list][list][*]Argenport Ringmaster will no longer lose Infiltrate if it fails to play units due to Reality Warden.[/*][/list][list][*]Argenport Ringmaster will no longer play 0 or negative health units with its infiltrate ability.[/*][/list][list][*]Jarrall Iceheart’s infiltrate trigger now has VFX to better message what is happening.[/*][/list][list][*]Xenan Cultist should no longer give +2/+2 to cudgels if the unit dying was turned into a cudgel.[/*][/list][list][*]The -3 strength from Mark of Shame should no longer apply to copies of the unit.[/*][/list][list][*]Opponents should now correctly get a response window to Feln Bloodcaster’s ultimate activation.[/*][/list][list][*]Damage that occurs to the opponent while Stonescar Leviathan’s entomb is triggering should now correctly occur after their health has been set. An easy example of this is sacrificing the Leviathan using Burn Out and targeting your opponent should now leave them at 2 health rather than 7.[/*][/list][list][*]Having multiple Vara, Fate-Touched attempt to play units from the void at the same time should no longer allow you to select the same unit for each Vara, causing selections to fail.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.16 - Patch Notes - Vara's Journey
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/fb311dc42cdfd447b27828356fc1ae4fdb891b76.jpg[/img]

[h1]1.16 Patch Notes[/h1]
[h1]New Totem[/h1]
The Argenport Silverwing has been added to the store for 600 gems! Showcasing the might of Justice, the Silverwing totem offers a variety of interactions to explore.
[list][*]Multiple points of interaction: Blast the horn, tap its head, flex its wings, and more![/*][/list]

[h1]5-Card Promo Quest: Vara's Journey[/h1]
5 new uncommons have been added! Earn a copy of each for your first win of the day in PvP while the promo is available! All of the cards will be available to create using Shiftstone after the promo ends.
[list][*]Fevered Scout - 3F Unit 2/2 When you play a spell, Fevered Scout gets +2/+2 this turn.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Find the Way - 2T Spell Echo. Draw a Sigil of your choice from your deck. It is Depleted when played.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Throne Warden - 5JJ Unit 4/4 Aegis. Summon: You gain 4 armor.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Borderlands Waykeeper - 2P Unit 1/3 Aegis. Ultimate: Pay 4 to give Borderlands Waykeeper +1 strength and Flying.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Xenan Cultist - 3SS Unit 2/4 When one of your other units is killed, that unit gets +2/+2.[/*][/list]
[h1]Wump, Party Starter Available for Crafting[/h1]
Wump, Party Starter can now be created and destroyed from My Cards.
[h1]Season Changes[/h1]
[list][*]When a season ends, players will now be placed at different starting ranks depending on where they ended the previous season.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Demotion logic has been adjusted to protect players from demoting too easily.[/*][/list]
[h1]Features[/h1]
[b]Network[/b]
[list][*]A network latency monitor has been added. Now, an icon will appear on screen if Eternal is experiencing latency issues. This appears both in the client and on the playmat.[/*][/list]
[b]Achievements[/b]
[list][*]New achievements have been added for reaching Master in the Gauntlet or Forge. If you’re already a Master, playing a single game should grant you the achievement.[/*][/list]
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Cards going to the void now play a VFX to smooth their transition.[/*][/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]Various UI improvements throughout the client.[/*][/list]
[list][*]A previewer has been added for totems in the store. You can now check out a totem before you buy it![/*][/list]
[list][*]You can now customize your keybinds and remap them to other keys.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The in-client clock is now always visible.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Right-clicking on a card tile in the decklist while in the deckbuilder will now auto-sort the card view on the left to that card’s location.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Playset completion tracking in the profile can now be toggled between 1-of, 4-of and premium 4-of sets.[/*][/list]
[b]AI[/b]
[list][*]Multiple improvements to how the AI plays and values various situations.[/*][/list]
[h1]Card Updates[/h1]
[b]Functional Changes[/b]
[i]Copies of the following cards that were previously crafted will be eligible for a full refund for two weeks.[/i]
[list][*]Shimmerpack - Power cost has increased from 7 to 8.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Excavate - Excavate can no longer leave the void.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Sand Warrior - Health has increased from 2 to 3.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Water of Life - Power cost has decreased from 2 to 1.[/*][/list]
[b]Non-Functional Changes[/b]
[list][*]Calderan Channeler - Art updated and name changed. Now: Calderan Gunsmith.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Sandstorm Titan - New VFX to clarify that units can’t fly.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Reality Warden - New VFX to clarify why cards can’t leave the void.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Scourge of Frosthome - New VFX to clarify why you can’t play spells.[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]Multiple fixes for controller interactions with the client.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Uninstalling Eternal will now correctly remove its local files.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Multiple iOS and Android performance improvements.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Gem purchases on Android should no longer get stuck during the process.[/*][/list][/list]
[list][b]UI[/b]
[list][*]Leaving the deckbuilder via a friend challenge should now prompt you to save your deck first.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Cancelling the deletion of a deck and then deleting another deck in the deckbuilder should now work correctly.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Relocated the mute option for the enemy player to not be blocked by their emotes.[/*][/list][/list]
[list][b]Quests[/b]
[list][*]The Big Guns quest should now be progressed when you play a Powersurge card at six or more power.[/*][/list][/list]
[list][b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]When a legendary unit is played from the Wanderer’s Wisdom boss power, it will no longer leave a temporary imprint of the card on the playmat.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Combat damage against a unit that has Deadly and negative strength will no longer make the opposing unit appear to die.[/*][/list][/list]
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Combrei Magister should no longer persist its invulnerable VFX for multiple turns if more than one power card is played.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Statuary Maiden’s transform ability should now correctly be blocked if the unit had Aegis.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Champion of Cunning will now correctly gain Flying if it was granted Flying after being silenced.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Brightmace Paladin will now correctly gain Lifesteal if it was granted Lifesteal after being silenced.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Infiltrating with Cabal Recruiter when you have a full board will now give you the option to sacrifice a unit in order to play the stolen unit.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Playing Vault of the Praxis after the second unit was played that turn will no longer draw a card after playing another unit that turn. It should only trigger on the second unit played.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Predator’s Instinct should now show the intended unit during response windows.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Rampage should now show the intended unit during response windows.[/*][/list]
[list][*]If Wump, Party Starter dies in response to being played, he should still deal damage for being summoned.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Armorsmith should no longer display a 0 power cost if stolen.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Reality Warden should no longer prevent enemy Spell Swipes from stealing the spell.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Player Aegis should now block the steal part of Spell Swipe. However, the affected spell will still be negated.[/*][/list]
[list][*]When Shimmerpack transforms units into Stone Cudgels due to an interaction with Statuary Maiden, all transformed units go to the void.[/*][/list]

[list][*]A previewer has been added for totems in the store. You can now check out a totem before you buy it![/*][/list]
[list][*]You can now customize your keybinds and remap them to other keys.[/*][/list]
[list][*]The in-client clock is now always visible.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Right-clicking on a card tile in the decklist while in the deckbuilder will now auto-sort the card view on the left to that card’s location.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Playset completion tracking in the profile can now be toggled between 1-of, 4-of and premium 4-of sets.[/*][/list]
[b]AI[/b]
[list][*]Multiple improvements to how the AI plays and values various situations.[/*][/list]
[h1]Card Updates[/h1]
[b]Functional Changes[/b]
[i]Copies of the following cards that were previously crafted will be eligible for a full refund for two weeks.[/i]
[list][*]Shimmerpack - Power cost has increased from 7 to 8.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Excavate - Excavate can no longer leave the void.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Sand Warrior - Health has increased from 2 to 3.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Water of Life - Power cost has decreased from 2 to 1.[/*][/list]
[b]Non-Functional Changes[/b]
[list][*]Calderan Channeler - Art updated and name changed. Now: Calderan Gunsmith.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Sandstorm Titan - New VFX to clarify that units can’t fly.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Reality Warden - New VFX to clarify why cards can’t leave the void.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Scourge of Frosthome - New VFX to clarify why you can’t play spells.[/*][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[b]Client Fixes[/b]
[list][b]General[/b]
[list][*]Multiple fixes for controller interactions with the client.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Uninstalling Eternal will now correctly remove its local files.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Multiple iOS and Android performance improvements.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Gem purchases on Android should no longer get stuck during the process.[/*][/list][/list]
[list][b]UI[/b]
[list][*]Leaving the deckbuilder via a friend challenge should now prompt you to save your deck first.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Cancelling the deletion of a deck and then deleting another deck in the deckbuilder should now work correctly.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Relocated the mute option for the enemy player to not be blocked by their emotes.[/*][/list][/list]
[list][b]Quests[/b]
[list][*]The Big Guns quest should now be progressed when you play a Powersurge card at six or more power.[/*][/list][/list]
[list][b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]When a legendary unit is played from the Wanderer’s Wisdom boss power, it will no longer leave a temporary imprint of the card on the playmat.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Combat damage against a unit that has Deadly and negative strength will no longer make the opposing unit appear to die.[/*][/list][/list]
[b]Card Fixes[/b]
[list][*]Combrei Magister should no longer persist its invulnerable VFX for multiple turns if more than one power card is played.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Statuary Maiden’s transform ability should now correctly be blocked if the unit had Aegis.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Champion of Cunning will now correctly gain Flying if it was granted Flying after being silenced.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Brightmace Paladin will now correctly gain Lifesteal if it was granted Lifesteal after being silenced.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Infiltrating with Cabal Recruiter when you have a full board will now give you the option to sacrifice a unit in order to play the stolen unit.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Playing Vault of the Praxis after the second unit was played that turn will no longer draw a card after playing another unit that turn. It should only trigger on the second unit played.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Predator’s Instinct should now show the intended unit during response windows.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Rampage should now show the intended unit during response windows.[/*][/list]
[list][*]If Wump, Party Starter dies in response to being played, he should still deal damage for being summoned.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Armorsmith should no longer display a 0 power cost if stolen.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Reality Warden should no longer prevent enemy Spell Swipes from stealing the spell.[/*][/list]
[list][*]Player Aegis should now block the steal part of Spell Swipe. However, the affected spell will still be negated.[/*][/list]
[list][*]When Shimmerpack transforms units into Stone Cudgels due to an interaction with Statuary Maiden, all transformed units go to the void.[/*][/list]

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26908411/5cce51b6cd510248698e95c7c2de62536df95cee.jpg[/img]

[h1]Holiday Promo Card[/h1]Promo Cards have returned for the holidays! Your first win of the day in Ranked will earn you 1 copy of Wump, Party Starter! Earn your four copies of Wump between now and January 9th! After that, both the regular and premium versions will be available to craft.

[h1]Beta Build Now Available on Android[/h1][i]Eternal[/i] is now available in the Google Play beta channel for Android devices. You can download the client directly [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.direwolfdigital.Phoenix] here[/url]. [list][*]There have been multiple performance improvements and mobile-specific bug fixes throughout the game to support our availability on Android.  Please continue to let us know if you run into issues![/*][/list][h1]Gamepad and Android TV Support[/h1][i]Eternal[/i] now has beta support for gamepad controllers for Android TV and Steam controllers!  Plug in your controller, sit back and engage in epic battles from the comfort of your couch!  Help us test this feature and let us know what you think!

[h1]Season Extension[/h1]The current season for Ranked and Draft will have a few additional days added, ending on January 3, 2017.

[h1]Features[/h1][b]Gameplay[/b][list][*]Multi-targeting selection for spells and abilities should be more clear about what is and isn’t selected.[/*][*]Returning to a game on reconnect is now faster.[/*][/list][b]UI[/b][list][*]Various UI improvements both in the client and on the playmat.[/*][*]Emotes now preview what you’re going to say on the button.[/*][*]New layout for ‘My Cards’.[/*][*]Better messaging about guaranteed Legendaries for box purchases.[/*][*]Updated the card frame for curses to better message their available target(s).[/*][/list][b]Microsoft Surface Improvements[/b][list][*]We’ve added a handful of improvements for how Eternal plays on Surface Pros. If you’re playing on this device, please let us know how it’s going![/*][/list][h1]Card Updates[/h1][list][*]A clarity pass has been made to the text box for Crown of Possibilities, Steward of the Past and Statuary Maiden to better identify their functionality. Functionality has not changed.[/*][/list][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][b]Client Fixes[/b][list][b]General[/b][list][*]Fixed several crash issues throughout the game.[/*][*]Various bug and UX fixes for inviting friends.[/*][*]Rarely, the Gauntlet would not register a win or loss. This should no longer happen.[/*][*]Achievements earned on an Eternal account that was playing on iPad or Android should now correctly get the Steam Achievement upon their next login through Steam.[/*][*]Rarely, you could get gated after selecting Keep or Redraw on the opening hand. This should no longer happen.[/*][*]Clicking “Done” on an imported deck without editing it should no longer delete the deck.[/*][*]Full-screen will now use your native resolution instead of forcing 4:3 or 16:9.[/*][/list][b]UI[/b][list][*]Fixed several minor UI issues throughout the client. You should no longer get into scenarios where the UI becomes unresponsive.[/*][*]All card reveals on the playmat should now close or collapse when you click outside of them.[/*][*]The opponent’s deck count should no longer be upside down.[/*][*]Rarely, the end turn button would stop responding, preventing you from ending your turn. This should no longer happen.[/*][/list][b]Quests[/b][list][*]Influence gained from Strangers should now correctly count toward the quests that require gaining influence in versus battle.[/*][/list][b]Gameplay[/b][list][*]Transforming a stunned unit into a unit with Endurance now correctly breaks stun.[/*][*]We added a handful of improvements to the AI to not waste card plays for no value.[/*][*]The amount of time given to block was incorrectly lower above 10 units in play. This has been corrected and the block time should continue to scale up to a max timer for a 12v12 board.[/*][*]Units that were permanently stunned, gained aegis, then gained endurance will now correctly keep their aegis and ready.[/*][*]Spells with Overwhelm now correctly damage the opponent if the targeted unit is removed in response to the spell.[/*][/list][/list][b]Card Fixes[/b][list][*]Snipe now displays VFX for its target during the response window.[/*][*]Rampage now displays VFX for its target during the response window.[/*][*]Scourge of Frosthome should now correctly prevent West-Wind Herald’s infiltrate ability and Privilege of Rank’s discard trigger.[/*][*]Copying North-Wind Herald should now maintain the same effects and influence costs as the original, returning to a cost of 6 at the end of the turn.[/*][*]Brazen Daredevil should no longer attack the enemy player from the void if she was killed in response to her attack.[/*][*]A stolen Oblivion Spike should now correctly update based on its new owner’s void.[/*][*]If both players have a Steward of the Past that dies at the same time, both should now become silenced instead of only one of them.[/*][*]Argenport Instigator should now correctly damage its owner if it was killed by an opponent’s Combust.[/*][*]Serpent Trainer will no longer lose its infiltrate if it fails to create its 2/2 flying due to being at the unit cap.[/*][*]Morningstar should now correctly export in deckbuilder.[/*][*]Hellfire Rifle should now correctly deal the 3 damage to the opponent if it is killed in response.[/*][*]Playing the same unit twice by returning it from the void should now correctly trigger Vault of the Praxis.[/*][*]Vault of the Praxis will now correctly draw a card if you play two Ambush units on your opponent’s turn, even if you played two units on your last turn.[/*][*]Feln Cauldron will now continue to create spells if your hand is full and discard them to the void.[/*][*]Ice Sprite should no longer remain visually linked to its target after it has been silenced.[/*][*]Feln Cauldron will now correctly create the five spells if replayed after being sacrificed.[/*]
